title: Lift Ko Kaise Pata Aap Kaun Si Floor Dabate Ho? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Kya lift camera se floor dekhti hai? Bilkul nahi! Jaano button dabane se lekar darwaza kholne tak ka poora khel.
🛗 Button dabane par signal kahan jata hai
🧠 Controller call ko memory mein kaise save karta hai
🧲 Shaft ke magnet aur sensor floor kaise gintey hain
💡 Button baar baar dabane ka sach
Aisi aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
#shorts #lift #elevator #howitworks #hindi #electronics
